description: List people (CRM contacts) who bought without a company — shop buyers: a purchase order without a company (processing, ready to ship, shipped, delivered or refunded, or with a settled payment) or a won deal of theirs without a company that never became an order. A company's purchases never count for the person who represents it. Filter by health, lifetime-value bucket, repeat (two or more purchases) or search over name, email and phone; sorted by lifetime value and paginated. Returns rows (id = contact id, firstName, lastName, email, phone, health, lifetimeValue, purchases, repeat, firstPurchaseAt, lastPurchaseAt, lastActivityAt) plus pagination { page, perPage, total }. Read-only. Use get_person_customer for one person by contact id; use list_customers for companies.

health.description: Filter by customer health. Omit for any. Allowed: healthy, at_risk, churned.

ltv.description: Filter by lifetime-value bucket. Omit for any. Allowed: lt10k, 10k50k, gt50k.

page.description: 1-based page number of results to return. Default 1.

perPage.description: Number of people per page (1-100). Default 25.

q.description: Free-text search over the person's first name, last name, email and phone. Omit for no text filter.

repeat.description: true = only people with two or more purchases; false or omitted = everyone.

sortDir.description: Sort direction by lifetime value. Default desc (highest first).

name: list_people_customers
title: List people who bought
